title: "Quick Fix" for Advanced Paste
author: nsathya2010
summary: Quick Fix could reuse Advanced Paste’s spelling transform but adds unsolved cross-application selection, replacement, clipboard restoration, and no-popup feedback semantics.

status.label: Design in progress
status.detail: The workflow is clear, but the prior artifact was not implementation-grade and must not expose approval.

next_action.label: Investigate in-place transform design
next_action.reason: Resolve selection capture, full-control fallback, clipboard history, focus restoration, and failure behavior.

judgment.rationale: The scenario is concrete enough for design, while current code supplies transform/paste primitives but not the full in-place selection lifecycle.
evidence: One trigger should correct selected text.
No selection should fall back to all editable text.
No window should open and clipboard history should stay clean.
Advanced Paste already implements FixSpellingAndGrammar over clipboard content and synthetic paste.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep design_in_progress, investigate cross-application interaction, and remove the premature approve_design action.

issue_context.summary: Quick Fix aims to transform the active edit control’s selection in place with one hotkey and minimal UI.
known_information: The transform is spelling and grammar correction.
It uses selected text or all editable text if none is selected.
It should replace text without opening Advanced Paste.
A lightweight busy indication is desired.
inferences: Arbitrary application support may require simulated copy/select-all/paste and focus restoration.
Preserving clipboard history may require restoring multiple clipboard formats.
issue_context.analysis: The feature merits a deeper design, but the prior action skipped required implementation investigation. Retain the candidate while removing approval.
initial_investigation: PasteFormatExecutor.cs already routes FixSpellingAndGrammar through the configured provider.
ClipboardHelper.cs writes transformed data and sends Ctrl+V.
Reviewed paths lack complete generic selection capture, select-all fallback, and clipboard restoration.
No assignee, duplicate, implementation, or acceptance is present.

information_gaps.information: Contract for applications without selectable editable controls or accepting simulated copy/paste.
information_gaps.why_needed: Sets supported scope and failure behavior.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Resolve in the full design against accessibility and input APIs; no reporter evidence is needed.
